units.source_text: 棋坛头号人物七段，以六岁和四岁的女儿为对手对弈，

en.t: The leading figure in the go world, a seventh dan, played games against his six-year-old and four-year-old daughters,

units.source_text: 他仿佛在认真考虑：自己的幼女若有天分，

en.t: as though he were seriously thinking that if his little girls had talent,

units.source_text: 让她们也同自己一样，成为棋手就好了。

en.t: it would be good to let them become go players, just as he had.

units.source_text: 一般来说，围棋的天分十岁左右就能表现出来，

en.t: Generally speaking, a talent for go shows itself around the age of ten,

units.source_text: 这个时候不学习就不能成才。

en.t: and unless one studies at that time, one cannot develop into a real player.

units.source_text: 但在我听来，大竹七段的话有点奇怪。

en.t: But to my ears, what Seventh Dan Otake said sounded a little strange.

units.source_text: 也许是痴迷围棋的他才三十岁，还处在尚未厌倦的年纪吧。

en.t: Perhaps, being only thirty and obsessed with go, he was still at an age when he had not yet grown tired of it.

units.source_text: 我想，他的家庭肯定是很幸福的。

en.t: I thought that his family must surely be very happy.
